title: Adding a standard transformer requires edits in both grafana-data and public/app
answers: What files do I need to touch to add a new data transformer?
Why does my new transformer not show up in the UI picker?
body:
1) Write the transformer in packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/transformers/<name>.ts.
2) Add its id to DataTransformerID enum in packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/transformers/ids.ts.
3) Export it from packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/transformers.ts (which itself is a deprecated direct-import surface — new code should go through standardTransformersRegistry instead).
4) Register a TransformerRegistryItem (editor component + light/dark SVG icons) in public/app/features/transformers/standardTransformers.tsx, feeding getStandardTransformers which app.ts wires into standardTransformersRegistry.
Skipping step 4 means transformDataFrame() can still execute the transformer if invoked directly with its id, but it never appears in the transformation picker UI.
applies: Only for 'standard' built-in transformers shipped in core; external/plugin-provided transformers register differently.
